stories.title: Can You Check That? The Checkability Boundary for Local LLM Network Automation
stories.reason: Touchstone gives a practical, measured rule (checkability) for when local small models can replace frontier-LLM calls in network automation — concrete inference-deployment tradeoff with numbers.
key_facts: 98.6% / 93.8% end-to-end accuracy on conflict-detection/intent-translation while escalating only 16-17% of inputs to a frontier LLM
Uses 7 off-the-shelf 1-8B SLMs plus task-specific deterministic checks
